name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  NODE_VERSION: "24.19.0"

jobs:
  # Parallel to `test` so lint, type and test failures surface on the same run. The package type
  # check (`pnpm build`) runs here rather than ahead of the tests, which do not need it: each test
  # task declares the codegen it reads. `scripts/` has its own type check, kept off `pnpm build`'s
  # hot path (see docs/build-system.md).
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # A wedged build would otherwise burn the 6-hour default, as `test` notes below.
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # Vite+ downloads its own pnpm for `vp install` and exposes no shim, so this is what puts
      # `pnpm` on PATH for the steps below.
      - name: Enable Corepack
        run: corepack enable

      # Vite+ resolves its own version from the `vite-plus` catalog entry, and installs the pnpm
      # named in `packageManager` (integrity hash checked as Corepack does), so setup-node is not
      # needed.
      #
      # No dependency cache in this workflow: restoring setup-vp's (~540 MB) takes longer than
      # letting `vp install` download the packages (setup p50 29 s cached, 20 s uncached).
      - name: Set up Vite+, Node.js and dependencies
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@3754dd7dbdb32bd8f6d28b6043de13ad3a75f21f # v1.21.1
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: false
          run-install: true

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm lint:check

      - name: Type-check scripts/
        run: pnpm types:scripts

      - name: Check generated worker configs
        run: pnpm configs:check

      # Codegen, the frontend/SPA bundles, and the repo's single type check (`types:check` aliases
      # this). It runs even when a step above failed, so a lint error does not hide a type error.
      - name: Build
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: pnpm build

  # The three slowest test tasks each get a runner, and every other package shares one. Each leg runs
  # the root `test` script's command (package.json) with its own filters; keep the two in step.
  test:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.name }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Without an explicit cap a wedged test process (a spawned child that outlives its reap keeps
    # `node --test` alive forever) burns the 6-hour default instead of failing, on every run of the
    # branch.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      # Let every leg finish, so one run reports every failing package.
      fail-fast: false
      # scripts/vp/concurrency.ts gives each suite 2 vitest workers, because it assumes 4 suites
      # share the 4 cores. A leg that tests one package runs one suite at a time, so it uses 3.
      # Measured in pairs on the same runner, 3 workers were faster in 8 of 9 pairs across the three
      # packages, by 22-26 s for the backend, which sets the run's pace.
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: workshop-backend
            filters: --filter=@gadgets/workshop-backend
            vitest-workers: 3
          - name: workshop-frontend
            filters: --filter=@gadgets/workshop-frontend
            vitest-workers: 3
            chromium: true
          - name: integration-tests
            filters: --filter=@gadgets/integration-tests
            vitest-workers: 3
          # Must exclude every package named above, or its tests run twice.
          - name: other packages
            filters: >-
              --filter=!cloudflare-os
              --filter=!@gadgets/workshop-backend
              --filter=!@gadgets/workshop-frontend
              --filter=!@gadgets/integration-tests
            # configurator-ui's browser suite and generated-frame test.
            chromium: true
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # Vite+ downloads its own pnpm for `vp install` and exposes no shim, so this is what puts
      # `pnpm` on PATH for the steps below.
      - name: Enable Corepack
        run: corepack enable

      # Vite+ resolves its own version from the `vite-plus` catalog entry, and installs the pnpm
      # named in `packageManager` (integrity hash checked as Corepack does), so setup-node is not
      # needed. No dependency cache, as `lint` explains.
      - name: Set up Vite+, Node.js and dependencies
        uses: voidzero-dev/setup-vp@3754dd7dbdb32bd8f6d28b6043de13ad3a75f21f # v1.21.1
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: false
          run-install: true

      # The frontend's and configurator-ui's browser suites (`vitest.browser.config.ts`), and
      # configurator-ui's generated-frame test, run in Chromium, which Playwright downloads outside
      # node_modules; both packages pin the catalog `playwright`, so one install serves them.
      # `--with-deps` adds the system libraries it needs.
      - name: Install Chromium for the browser suite
        if: ${{ matrix.chromium }}
        run: pnpm --filter @gadgets/workshop-frontend exec playwright install --with-deps chromium

      # `vp run` exits 0 when a filter matches no package, so a renamed package would pass its leg
      # having run nothing. `--fail-if-no-match` makes that an error.
      # Sets `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS` only when the leg asks: an empty value would count as explicit
      # and leave every suite at vitest's own default.
      - name: Test
        env:
          FILTERS: ${{ matrix.filters }}
          VITEST_WORKERS: ${{ matrix.vitest-workers }}
        run: |
          [ -z "$VITEST_WORKERS" ] || export VITEST_MAX_WORKERS="$VITEST_WORKERS"
          node scripts/vp/run.ts --cache --fail-if-no-match $FILTERS test

  # main's ruleset requires a check with exactly this name: renaming the job blocks every merge. It
  # passes only if every `test` leg passed. `always()` because a skipped required check counts as
  # passed, and without it a failed or cancelled leg would skip this job.
  build-and-test:
    name: Build and test
    needs: test
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require every test leg to pass
        env:
          RESULT: ${{ needs.test.result }}
        run: test "$RESULT" = success

{
  "name": "@gadgets/mcp-shared",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    "./account": "./src/account.ts",
    "./base-types": "./src/base-types.ts",
    "./client": "./src/client.ts",
    "./connect-nonce": "./src/connect-nonce.ts",
    "./connection": "./src/connection.ts",
    "./endpoint": "./src/endpoint.ts",
    "./fetch": "./src/fetch.ts",
    "./facet": "./src/facet.ts",
    "./html": "./src/html.ts",
    "./http": "./src/http.ts",
    "./log": "./src/log.ts",
    "./portal": "./src/portal.ts",
    "./schema-to-ts": "./src/schema-to-ts.ts",
    "./scope": "./src/scope.ts",
    "./session": "./src/session.ts",
    "./tools": "./src/tools.ts",
    "./types": "./src/types.d.ts",
    "./user": "./src/user.ts",
    "./util": "./src/util.ts"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json",
    "clean": "rm -rf dist",
    "test:run": "vitest run"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@gadgets/gatekeeper-kit": "workspace:*",
    "@gadgets/observability": "workspace:*",
    "@gadgets/workshop-shared": "workspace:*",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/client": "2.2.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@gadgets/scripts": "workspace:*",
    "@types/node": "^26.1.0",
    "typescript": "catalog:",
    "typescript6": "catalog:",
    "vitest": "catalog:"
  }
}

{
  "name": "@gadgets/mcp-gatekeeper",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "type": "module",
  "main": "./src/mcp.ts",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "echo \"run 'pnpm dev-server' in the root directory instead\" >&2 && exit 1",
    "deploy": "vp run --no-cache build:configurator && wrangler deploy",
    "clean": "rm -rf dist src/generated",
    "test:run": "vitest run"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@gadgets/configurator-ui": "workspace:*",
    "@gadgets/gatekeeper-kit": "workspace:*",
    "@gadgets/mcp-shared": "workspace:*",
    "@gadgets/observability": "workspace:*",
    "@gadgets/workshop-shared": "workspace:*",
    "capnweb": "catalog:",
    "capnweb-validate": "catalog:"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@gadgets/scripts": "workspace:*",
    "typescript": "catalog:",
    "vitest": "catalog:",
    "wrangler": "catalog:"
  }
}
